name: runtime description shared by Gateway CLI and MCP

bootstrapSkill.name: promptcard-bootstrap
bootstrapSkill.instructions: Discover the exact Workspace first, stop on a stale or revoked CVC, copy approved four-field Skill pins unchanged, follow the closed kind-specific Tool schema, preview before commit, and stop for visual review.

tools.name: promptcard_runtime_describe
tools.description: Describe the Bridge contract and return the built-in Bootstrap Skill instructions, Tools, limits, and next discovery step.

tools.name: promptcard_workspace_describe
tools.description: Describe one explicit PRJ/CVC workspace, Skill pins, objects, and pending proposals.

tools.name: promptcard_skill_read
tools.description: Read one user-approved exact Skill revision.

tools.name: promptcard_reference_resolve
tools.description: Resolve an exact typed public reference inside its project scope.

tools.name: promptcard_prompt_search
tools.description: Search bounded Prompt evidence; results are discovery-only.

tools.name: promptcard_asset_read
tools.description: Read one explicitly authorized bounded asset.

tools.name: promptcard_delivery_preview
tools.description: Validate one closed typed creative writeback described by bootstrapSkill.instructions and create or replay its preview.

tools.name: promptcard_delivery_commit
tools.description: Commit a preview to the visual review queue; never auto-apply it.

tools.name: promptcard_delivery_status
tools.description: Read delivery state without repeating its mutation.

tools.name: promptcard_asset_stage
tools.description: Stage one validated workspace image and return an opaque handle.

instance.next: Ask the user to select a project and create or choose a CVC, then call promptcard_workspace_describe.
